body_topology.body_face_selection: explicit physical body-face labels mapped to imported rest mesh

method: Every actual tetra translated along the full segment has an exact eight-endpoint convex prism hull; union over all tetrahedra is the complete frozen solid sweep.

AABB rejection with 1e-10m allowance, then full actual body triangle Sutherland-Hodgman clipping against all normalized hull halfspaces. Nonempty clipped polygons detect swept faces/interiors/edges and do not rely on vertex samples.
All intersecting tetra/body-face pairs are checked; each touched face stores contact-Z range and a maximum-area clipped-polygon witness. Reported polygon areas are not union surface areas.
Actual/world and rest triangle-to-rim-polyline distances include segment/triangle interior intersection, endpoint-to-triangle distance and all edge/segment distances.

Rest body-mesh shortest edge paths are vertex distances and generally overestimate continuous material geodesics. Rest 3D triangle-to-rim distance is instead a lower bound on any rest-surface material path.
limitations: Frozen body-volume/cloth intersection is a risk localization, not observed penetration or force; deformable contact may move the cloth.
This cannot authorize lateral traversal through a closed wall; parent separately evaluates opening topology and trial policy.
1e-10m expanded clipping may conservatively include numerical tangency.
